front: Bully a creature into compliance with at least 1 minute of threats, using Intimidation against its Will DC.
back:
Intimidation vs. Will DC after 1 minute of conversation.
Crit Success: target gives info or complies if not harmful, up to the GM's time (max 1 day), then becomes unfriendly (if not already unfriendly/hostile); too scared to retaliate short term.
Success: as crit success, but once unfriendly it might act against you (e.g. report you).
Failure: refuses; becomes unfriendly if not already unfriendly/hostile.
Crit Failure: refuses, becomes hostile, immune to your Coercion for 1 week.
